title: Des Moines Register, obituary of Ronald E. Totosz (18 August 2004)
citation: Obituary, "RONALD E. TOTOSZ, Ankeny," Des Moines Register, Wednesday 18 August 2004, Metro section p. 7 col. 5, repeated identically on obituaries p. 25. newspapers.com images 130714050 and 131380041; permanent clippings 203981098 (p. 7) and 203981158 (p. 25). Records: born 10 October 1941 in Chicago, Illinois; died 12 August 2004 of a brain tumour at Taylor House Hospice; bio tech at Iowa Methodist Hospital for 25 years; survived by wife Okhe, daughter Nina (Tony) Xiong, grandson Anthony, brother Frank (Judith) Totosz Jr., sisters Alice Totosz and Virginia (Bernard) Janssen. Includes a later-life portrait photograph.
notes: Fixes his dates and family. The birth year makes him 23 during Larry’s tour, beside Larry’s own age. Note what it does not say: the obituary makes no mention of military service at all, which is common and is why the 1962 enlistment list carries that part alone. The 2004 death date is 22 years earlier than Larry’s "about ten years ago" — a soft anchor, recorded as a discrepancy rather than treated as a problem with the identification. The full text is transcribed in research/people/ron-tototz-search.md so the finding survives loss of access. Located through the Des Moines Public Library newspaper index, which gave the exact section, page and column; the Register is the source, the index the route.
